description: Discover sittings with mode sittings and year. Mode vote_items lists what a sitting voted on: its PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS vote items in published order, each with its title label, based-on documents, procedures, recording documents and decision_count, from one sitting-wide read; pass a vote_item_id to decisions mode for its decisions. Vote items on sittings before 2024 publish no decision links, so decision_count is absent there. Default decisions pages compact summaries with labels, separate decided-on, part-of and recording document relations, and vote items for sitting_id. Vote items, decisions and voters return the requested whole-item count or remaining rows without an output-size cap. Optional label_contains, in decisions or vote_items, selects a literal selected-language substring of decision labels (report citations, amendments) or vote item titles, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and dash style without altering published text or establishing a final vote; in a decision label a document_ids entry is cited with its prefix and term joined and the year after the number, so A-9-2022-0116 is A9-0116/2022 and the joint motion RC-9-2022-0257 is RC-B9-0257/2022. Optional document_id filters decisions before paging by exact document identity or hyphen-boundary descendant; optional vote_item_id, such as a procedure's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS event, selects every decision of that vote item. Mode decision requires decision_id and returns one rich record with reference text and commentary; it rejects nondefault paging and snapshot. Optional decisions or decision mep_id returns independent recorded and intended positions with publication availability, without a roster lookup; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote. Mode voters requires decision_id and one position, paging recorded and intended voters independently. Missing arrays succeed with available false; published empty arrays have available true. Optional resolve_names requires explicit roster_term and joins only published names from that complete term roster, never voting-date affiliations or current-roster substitutes. Some IDs may remain unresolved. Continue local vote items, decisions or voters with page.next_offset and snapshot; restart at offset 0 without snapshot after snapshot_changed. Missing sitting vote items or decisions succeed empty; absent selected decision fails decision_not_found.

decision_id.description: Required for decision and voters: exact returned canonical decision ID, known eli/dl/event/ prefix, or exact public event URI; forbidden for sittings, vote_items and decisions.

document_id.description: Decisions-only document filter: canonical ID, eli/dl/doc/ prefix or exact public URI, in any letter case, or a report, adopted-text, motion or agenda citation such as A9-0188/2023, P9_A(2023)0188, T9-0138/2024, B9-0163/2024 (the B- motion) or RC-B9-0163/2024. Matches decided-on, part-of or recording relations by exact ID or hyphen-boundary descendant before paging.

label_contains.description: Decisions or vote_items literal substring of the selected-language label, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and dash style, applied before paging. Decision labels carry report citations and amendment numbers and combine with document_id and vote_item_id; in a decision label a document_ids entry is cited with its prefix and term joined and the year after the number, so A-9-2022-0116 is A9-0116/2022 and the joint motion RC-9-2022-0257 is RC-B9-0257/2022. Vote item labels are titles such as Artificial Intelligence Act. Matching text does not establish a final vote.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20. Whole-acquired local collections return the requested count or remaining rows, without an output-size cap. Bounded-mode acquisition limits: 1000 sittings. Larger bounded-mode limits normalize with a notice. Values above the safe-integer range normalize to 9007199254740991; search windows and bounded modes may narrow further.

mep_id.description: Decisions or decision member lookup: canonical numeric ID, person/ prefix or exact public person URI. Uses published arrays without a roster join; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote.

mode.description: Default decisions returns compact summaries; sittings discovers by year, vote_items lists the vote items of sitting_id, decision returns one rich record, voters pages one position.

position.description: Required only for voters: favor, against, abstention, intended_favor, intended_against, or intended_abstention.

resolve_names.description: Default false retains IDs only; true is voters-only and requires roster_term for complete names-only roster resolution.

roster_term.description: Explicit parliamentary term 0–10 containing the sitting; required with resolve_names true, forbidden otherwise. No term is inferred from dates.

sitting_id.description: Required outside sittings: real YYYY-MM-DD date, MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD, known event prefix, or exact public event URI.

snapshot.description: Returned vote-item, decisions or voter-position snapshot; required for local offset above 0, optional at offset 0; forbidden for sittings and decision.

vote_item_id.description: Decisions-only vote item filter: canonical MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD-VOT-ITM- ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or exact public event URI, such as a procedure's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS event, a vote_items row or a returned vote_item_ids entry. Selects every decision of that vote item before paging; its date must match sitting_id.

year.description: Four-digit year, required only for sittings and forbidden in other modes.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Identifier, calendar date, year, term, or language is unsupported, or vote_item_id belongs to a different sitting date than sitting_id. `invalid_mode_fields`: Required mode fields are missing, incompatible fields are supplied, or local continuation lacks a snapshot. `snapshot_changed`: Complete selected vote items, decisions, voters, resolved names, or normalized retrieval scope changed. `decision_not_found`: The selected decision is absent from the complete sitting collection. `upstream_paging_stalled`: Complete name-resolution roster acquisition repeats a page before exhaustion, or the vote-results read omits a vote item its sitting lists. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
